about_the_game:
Regarding the DEMO of "Psychic Detective":

Compared to the full version, the demo version will receive continuous updates. The first phase of the full version is planned to consist of four chapters, while the demo version will receive free updates for the first three chapters.

That's right, this means you can play the first three chapters for free in the DEMO version. (Currently, the first chapter has been updated.)

When the official version is released, that is, when Chapter 4 is published, Chapter 4 will be integrated with the previous three chapters and sold together with the official version.

You can consider whether to purchase the entire game after playing the first three chapters.

If the feedback on the official version is positive, we will consider continuing to update the storyline after the official version for free. (After that, the demo version will no longer be updated.)

Creation background:

"One day, when I began to ponder the meaning of life... I decided to create a game."

"This is the story I want to tell you."

"And thus, my story with you all begins."

Regarding the game:

"Mind Detective" is an independently developed puzzle, drama, and interactive novel game. You need to follow six partners with different backgrounds, ages, and personalities, shuttling between the inner world and the real world, searching for the deepest secrets buried in people's hearts.

You will run a murder mystery game shop with these six partners, but besides your main business, you also have a sideline - psychological counseling. One of the members, "Z", in order to better cooperate with psychological counseling, designed a program that can enter people's inner world. This program allows you to freely explore people's inner thoughts and discover the deepest secrets hidden in their hearts.

Thus, you embarked on a spiritual journey.

The gameplay is quite simple. Use the [direction keys] on the numeric keypad to control the character to explore the map, trigger the plot or solve puzzles.

The story of the game is linear, with no multiple endings or hidden paths. There may be choices in the game, but these choices will not affect the final outcome.

The game may contain psychological implications, mild horror scenes, and content related to bloodshed, killing, and face-jumping.

The game will feature elements of chasing and maze content.

Operation mode:

Direction keys control movement, space bar for interaction, Shift to run, ESC for menu

Zoom in on the F5 window, and press Alt+Ent to go full screen

Game Features:

*Unique visuals and narrative style!

*A more "Chinese-style" and deeply rooted plot!

*Six companions you will definitely fall in love with!

*Rich original music!

Introduction to the main characters:

Name: Z

Gender: Male

Zodiac: Scorpio

Age: 25 years old

MBTI：INTJ

Introduction: The creator of the program "Peering into People's Inner World" tends to be rational and decisive in many decision-making processes, but he seems to have a less accurate grasp of "human touch". He usually gives off an indifferent and mysterious vibe, and he rarely expresses his inner thoughts through words. It seems as if he has some unknown secrets hidden within him ..

Name: Mou Duo

Gender: Female

Zodiac: Aries

Age: 23

MBTI：ENFJ

Introduction: The "store manager" with a straightforward and passionate personality. She always steps forward without hesitation to address any "need". When dealing with her closest friends, she always exhibits a sense of responsibility and is thoughtful. Perhaps to outsiders, she appears as an elder sister, a female knight-like figure. However, perhaps no one has ever seen her vulnerability.

Name: Wolf

Gender: Male

Zodiac: Leo

Age: 22 years old

MBTI：ESFP

Introduction: If you could meet him, he would definitely give you a barrage of words. "My happiness is the most important thing." It seems that even if the sky falls, it's okay, because he has his mouth to support it. "Eat and drink as you should, don't take anything to heart." Free and easy is his attitude towards life, and humor and being humble is a portrayal of his life. "So what, what can you do?"

Name: Fanfan

Gender: Male

Zodiac: Aquarius

Age: 22 years old

MBTI：ENFP

Introduction: A compassionate and lively cute little boy, known as "Happy Puppy". He always exudes a childlike innocence, full of curiosity. He is filled with a desire to explore, seemingly possessing endless energy, always ready to embark on a new adventure. Since he has few worries, he was named "Fanfan".

Name: Yuli

Gender: Female

Zodiac: Pisces

Age: 21

MBTI：ISFJ

Introduction: A simple and gentle, romantic and delicate "female college student". She always takes good care of her friends around her. She advocates "love and freedom". Her heart is always filled with a sense of justice. She always firmly believes that the world is beautiful. She believes that there must be light to illuminate those dark corners.

Name: Hua

Gender: Female

Zodiac: Libra

Age: 15 years old

MBTI：INFP

Introduction: She is the small-scale owner of a murder mystery game shop. Born into a wealthy family, she is known as a "princess". Her mother opened this murder mystery game shop solely for her interest. As her parents are abroad for most of the time, she is entrusted to her older sister, Mou Duo, for care. She is not particularly talkative. Her personality is solitary and reserved. To outsiders, she may appear to be an inconspicuous little girl. But... is it really like this?
